title: msrp_gateway Module
content_markdown: This module implements a Gateway for translating between Page Mode (SIP MESSAGE method) and Session Mode (MSRP) Instant Messaging.
overview: This module implements a Gateway for translating between Page Mode (SIP MESSAGE method) and Session Mode (MSRP) Instant Messaging.
how_it_works: The module makes use of the _msrp_ua_ module's API for the MSRP UAC/UAS functionalities.

exported_parameters.name: hash_size
exported_parameters.description: The size of the hash table that stores the gateway session information. It is the 2 logarithmic value of the real size.

exported_parameters.name: cleanup_interval
exported_parameters.description: The interval between full iterations of the sessions table in order to clean up lingering sessions.

exported_parameters.name: session_timeout
exported_parameters.description: Amount of time (in seconds) since last message has been received from either side, after which a session should be terminated.

exported_parameters.name: message_timeout
exported_parameters.description: Amount of time (in seconds) since last MESSAGE has been received after which a session should be terminated.

exported_functions.name: msrp_gw_answer

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: gateway session key to be used to correlate the MESSAGE requests with the MSRP side SIP session. A simple example would be to build this key based on the From and To URIs from both sides(from the initial MSRP leg INVITE and SIP MESSAGE requests respectively).

parameters.name: content_types
parameters.description: content types adevertised in the SDP offer on the MSRP side SIP session.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: From URI to be used for building SIP MESSAGE requests.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: To URI to be used for building SIP MESSAGE requests.

parameters.name: ruri
parameters.description: Request-URI to be used for building SIP MESSAGE requests.

exported_functions.description:
This functions initializes a new gateway session by answering an initial INVITE from the MSRP side SIP session. After running this function the call will be completely handled by the MSRP UA engine and MSRP SEND requests will be automatically translated to SIP MESSAGE requests.

The SIP From, To, and RURI coordinates for building MESSAGE requests are passed as parameters to the function.

exported_functions.name: msg_to_msrp

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: gateway session key to be used to correlate the MESSAGE requests with the MSRP side SIP session. A simple example would be to build this key based on the From and To URIs from both sides(from the initial MSRP leg INVITE and SIP MESSAGE requests respectively).

parameters.name: content_types
parameters.description: content types adevertised in the SDP offer on the MSRP side SIP session.

exported_functions.description:
This functions translates a SIP MESSAGE request into a MSRP SEND request. The function will initialize a new gateway session and establish the MSRP side SIP session if it is not done so already by a previous call.

The SIP From, To, and RURI coordinates for the new MSRP side session are taken from the MESSAGE request and mirrored back when translating a MSRP SEND to SIP MESSAGE with _msrp_gw_answer_.

exported_events.name: E_MSRP_GW_SETUP_FAILED
exported_events.description:
This event is triggered when the MSRP side SIP session fails to set up, when using the _msg\_to\_msrp()_ function.

The event can be used to generate a message with the failure description, back on the MESSAGE side.

parameters.name: from_uri
parameters.description: The URI in the SIP From header to use on the MESSAGE side.

parameters.name: to_uri
parameters.description: The URI in the SIP To header to use on the MESSAGE side.

parameters.name: ruri
parameters.description: The SIP Request URI to use on the MESSAGE side.

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: The SIP error code in the negative reply received on the MSRP side. Might be NULL if the MSRP UA session expired before receiving a negative reply.

parameters.name: reason
parameters.description: The SIP reason string in the negative reply received on the MSRP side. Might be NULL if the MSRP UA session expired before receiving a negative reply.
